## English

This directory contains the file-system layer of the 4.5BSD kernel — miscfs/procfs.

`config.mk` records 9 source file(s) here: `procfs_ctl.c`, `procfs_fpregs.c`, `procfs_mem.c`, `procfs_note.c`, `procfs_regs.c`, `procfs_status.c`, `procfs_subr.c`, `procfs_vfsops.c`, `procfs_vnops.c`.

These `config.mk` lists are reference metadata from the 4.5BSD tree; the BSD45 build scripts (`build_kernel.ps1` / `build_kernel.sh`) select the files that are actually compiled.
